camel_example: aliyun ons OnsTrendGroupOutputTps --region cn-hangzhou --Type 0 --EndTime 1570868400000 --InstanceId MQ_INST_111111111111_DOxxxxxx --BeginTime 1570852800000 --Period 10 --Topic test --GroupId GID_test
description_en: Queries the message consumption statistics for a specified group ID over a period of time
description_zh: 查询指定的Group ID在一段时间内消费消息的统计信息
kebab_example: aliyun ons ons-trend-group-output-tps --group-id GID_test --topic test --begin-time 1570852800000 --end-time 1570868400000 --type 0 --instance-id MQ_INST_111111111111_DOxxxxxx --period 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: OnsTrendGroupOutputTps

parameters.help_en: The ID of the group to query
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the topic to query
parameters.name: topic

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询区间的起始时间戳，单位：毫秒
parameters.name: begin_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询区间的终止时间戳，单位：毫秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The type of information to query. Valid values:

0: The statistical curve of the total number of consumed messages.

1: The statistical curve of the TPS for message consumption
parameters.help_zh:
查询的类型。取值说明如下：

0：查询消费消息总量的统计曲线。
1：查询消费消息TPS的统计曲线
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance to which the group belongs
parameters.help_zh: 需统计数据的Group ID所对应的实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The sampling period. Unit: minutes. Valid values: 1, 5, and 10
parameters.help_zh: 采样周期，单位：分钟，取值可为 1、5、10
parameters.name: period

X.description_en: The x-axis, which indicates the timestamp in milliseconds

Y.description_en: The y-axis, which indicates the data value. The data can be the TPS or the total number of messages

XUnit.description_en: The unit of the x-axis. The time is measured in ms

YUnit.description_en: The unit of the y-axis. The value can be the number of consumed messages (msg) or the TPS for message consumption (msg/min)
YUnit.description_zh: 纵轴单位。统计的消息消费数量msg，或者统计的消息消费TPS msg/min

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. This is a common parameter. Each request has a unique ID that you can use to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 公共参数，每个请求的ID都是唯一的，可用于排查和定位问题
